verdict.rationale: The docs index links a 'Migrate' section pointing to a MOLT migration overview, so a documented migration path exists. PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility also eases moving Postgres-based apps. Nothing in the pack describes how the import works or whether it achieves minimal downtime. Missing for 10: details of the MOLT import/migration tooling, evidence of minimal-downtime or live migration (e.g. replication/cutover from a source database), supported source databases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of production migrations.
